name: Mali
summary_text: Mali is a place trans visitors should avoid entirely. In October-November 2024 the Transitional National Council adopted a new penal code criminalising homosexuality for the first time — with the Justice Minister declaring that anyone “engaging in, promoting or apologising for” same-sex relations will be prosecuted; vague drafting suggests broad application, and prior “public indecency” provisions (Art 225) were already used against gender-nonconforming people. The junta context means no independent judiciary, no civil society space, and active conflict in much of the country. For a visitor: a brand-new criminalisation statute under a junta with no recourse, plus conflict conditions.

sources.title: New Mali Law Disastrous for LGBT People | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch (Nov 2024): 'New Mali Law Disastrous for LGBT People' — the 2024 penal code criminalises same-sex conduct with harsh penalties.
NOTE: Not retrievable at research time (HTTP 403); the underlying Human Dignity Trust country profile documents Mali's new criminalisation of same-sex conduct.

sources.title: Mali’s military junta has made homosexuality a crime – what the new law says
sources.claim_summary: The Conversation (Jan 2025), interview with anthropologist Christophe Broqua: Mali's new penal code (announced October 2024, in effect 13 December 2024) criminalises homosexuality and any citizen seen to encourage it - a sharp escalation under the military junta, alongside clampdowns on opposition and media.
US State Department 2021 Human Rights Report for Mali: official assessment - same-sex conduct not criminalised but significant societal stigma; violence and instability from armed groups.
US State Department 2011 Human Rights Report for Mali: documents gender inequality, FGM, corruption, and 'discrimination based on sexual orientation' among other human-rights problems.

sources.title: Le nouveau Code de la famille au Mali : une véritable régression pour les droits des femmes
sources.claim_summary: FIDH (Jan 2012, in French): 'Le nouveau Code de la famille au Mali: une véritable régression pour les droits des femmes' - the promulgated Family Code entrenches discrimination against women, a regression from the original intent to harmonise with international conventions - context for Mali's family-law framework.
